notes:
Inbound SMB signup from a product-led trial. Small vertical SaaS for independent property managers — uses chat for tenant queries + KB search for docs and lease summaries.

Background / context:
- Self-serve signup via hosted API (using trial credits). Onboarded two devs; basic SDK integration completed last week.
- Primary objective: replace brittle keyword search with embeddings + reranking for KB and add a small assistant for common tenant questions.
- Traffic profile expected: bursty daytime usage, ~20-30 reqs/sec at peak initially, ~100k tokens/day estimate for MVP.

Key technical/questions raised on call (11/15) — wants granular answers about model tradeoffs:
- "Which model gives us the best cost/quality for short conversational replies (5-40 tokens) and embeddings?"
- Interested in 7B-class models vs 13B for latency/cost. Mentioned Llama-2 family, Mistral-instruct variants, and Qwen-lite options.
- Asks: can Redwood do automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variants when load spikes? How seamless is model routing?
- Wants sample cost estimates for: Llama-2-7B-q4 vs Mistral-7B-instruct vs Qwen-7B-small for 100k tokens/day.

Performance/requirements:
- Latency target: 150-400ms p50 for chat reply (dev acknowledges p99 can be higher).
- Throughput: eventual steady 10-30 RPS, planning autoscaling but prefers predictable cost.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Will opt for cheaper 7B quantized variants if quality loss is minimal.
- Quality sensitivity: medium for transactional answers, high for legal/lease summaries (those get human review).

Security/compliance notes:
- SMB but uses Okta SSO. Wants SAML for Console access and audit logs for tokens and usage. Data residency not required — US cloud okay.

POC plan proposed by AE/SE:
- 7-day A/B evaluation: pick top-3 models (one Llama-2-7B-quant, one Mistral-7B-instruct, one Qwen-7B-small) -> run representative prompt set (50 prompts: chat + summarization + rerank).
- Measure: response quality (team-rated), tokens/response cost, p50/p95 latency, error rates.
- Redwood action: provide estimated cost curves and suggested quantization/batching config for hosted API.

Recent activity (timeline):
- 2024-11-06: self-serve signup, trial credits auto-provisioned.
- 2024-11-12: SDK integration (dev sandbox) completed — basic generate/embeddings calls working.
- 2024-11-15: Discovery call (Fireflies ff-20241115-NEB001) w/ Maya + Ronan + 2 Nebula devs. Collected prompts and acceptance criteria.
- 2024-11-18: Sent model selection brief + preliminary cost estimate (drive://nebulabloom/pricing-vs-cost-analysis-2024.pdf).
- 2024-11-20: SE follow-up; agreed POC scope and data exchange for sample prompts.

Quotes / direct notes from dev team:
- "Open to Llama if quantized perf is close — we need to hit < $X per active tenant per month."
- "If Redwood can route to a q4 variant automatically when load spikes, that would sell us."

Next steps / proposed owner actions:
- SE (Ronan) to schedule 45m tech Q&A and map sample prompt set to evaluation harness.
- Sales (Maya) to send trial usage playbook and cost calculator link.
- Run 7-day POC comparing the three models; capture quality scores + cost/latency metrics.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Pricing granularity for hosted_api (per-token vs bundled). Need example invoices for 100k/500k tokens.
- Clear guidance on quantized model availability on hosted offering and expected latency delta.
- Can we expose model routing policies on self-serve (simple GUI) or is it enterprise-only?

Summary sentiment: Warm lead — strong product fit for hosted API. Main decision hinge: demonstrable cost savings with acceptable quality on smaller models + ease of routing and visibility in Console.
